listen_host.description: The IP address to listen on.

listen_tls.description: When true, IPA will host API behind TLS.

enable_auto_tls.description: Enables auto-generating TLS parameters when listen_tls is False.

auto_tls_allowed_clock_skew.description: Clock skew (in seconds) allowed in the generated TLS certificate.

advertise_host.description: The host to tell Ironic to reply and send commands to.

advertise_port.description: The port to tell Ironic to reply and send commands to.

advertise_protocol.description: Protocol to use for the callback URL.

ip_lookup_attempts.description: The number of times to try and automatically determine the agent IPv4 address.

ip_lookup_sleep.description: The amount of time to sleep between attempts to determine IP address.

network_interface.description: The interface to use when looking for an IP address.

lookup_timeout.description: The amount of time to retry the initial lookup call to Ironic.

lookup_interval.description: The initial interval for retries on the initial lookup call to Ironic.

lldp_timeout.description: The amount of seconds to wait for LLDP packets.

collect_lldp.description: DEPRECATED: Whether IPA should attempt to receive LLDP packets for each network interface.

inspection_callback_url.description: Endpoint(s) to send inspection data to.

inspection_collectors.description: Comma-separated list of plugins providing additional hardware data for inspection.

inspection_dhcp_wait_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for the PXE NIC to get its IP address via DHCP before inspection.

inspection_dhcp_all_interfaces.description: Whether to wait for all interfaces to get their IP addresses before inspection.

hardware_initialization_delay.description: How much time (in seconds) to wait for hardware to initialize before proceeding with any actions.

disk_wait_attempts.description: The number of times to try and check to see if at least one suitable disk has appeared in inventory.

disk_wait_delay.description: How much time (in seconds) to wait between attempts to check if at least one suitable disk has appeared.

cafile.description: Path to PEM encoded Certificate Authority file to use when verifying HTTPS connections.

certfile.description: Path to PEM encoded client certificate cert file.

keyfile.description: Path to PEM encoded client certificate key file.

introspection_daemon.description: When the ``ironic-collect-introspection-data`` command is executed, continue running as a background process.

introspection_daemon_post_interval.description: The interval in seconds by which to transmit data to the bare metal introspection service in daemon mode.

ntp_server.description: Address of a single NTP server against which the agent should sync the system software clock.

fail_if_clock_not_set.description: If operations should fail if the clock time sync fails to complete successfully.

agent_token.description: Pre-shared token to use when working with the ironic API.

image_server_user.description: Pre-shared username used in Basic Auth process against the http(s) server that hosts the disk image.

image_server_password.description: Pre-shared password used in Basic Auth process against the http(s) server that hosts the disk image.

image_server_auth_strategy.description: Option to select authentication strategy used during communication with the server that hosts the disk images.

agent_token_required.description: Control to enforce if API command requests should enforce token validation.

image_download_connection_timeout.description: The connection timeout (in seconds) when downloading an image.

image_download_connection_retries.description: How many times to retry the connection when downloading an image.

image_download_connection_retry_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between two attempts to establish connection when downloading an image.

enable_vlan_interfaces.description: Comma-separated list of VLAN interfaces to enable.

ignore_bootloader_failure.description: If the agent should ignore failures to install a bootloader configuration into UEFI NVRAM.

inject_files_priority.description: Priority of the inject_files deploy step.

guard_special_filesystems.description: Guard "special" shared device filesystems from cleaning by the stock hardware manager's cleaning methods.

md5_enabled.description: If the MD5 algorithm is enabled for file checksums.

http_request_timeout.description: Time in seconds to wait for an HTTP request TCP socket used by an API request.

config_drive_rebuild.description: If the agent should rebuild the configuration drive using a local filesystem.

disable_deep_image_inspection.description: This disables the additional deep image inspection the agent does before converting and writing an image.

permitted_image_formats.description: The supported list of image formats which are permitted for deployment with Ironic Python Agent.

disable_bootc_deploy.description: This disables bootc deployment methods in the ramdisk.

check_device_interval.description: After Ironic has completed creating the partition table, it continues to check for activity on the attached iSCSI device status at this interval.

check_device_max_retries.description: The maximum number of times to check that the device is not accessed by another process.

efi_system_partition_size.description: Size of EFI system partition in MiB when configuring UEFI systems for local boot.

bios_boot_partition_size.description: Size of BIOS Boot partition in MiB when configuring GPT partitioned systems for local boot in BIOS.

dd_block_size.description: Block size to use when writing to the nodes disk.

partition_detection_attempts.description: Maximum attempts to detect a newly created partition.

partprobe_attempts.description: Maximum number of attempts to try to read the partition.

image_convert_memory_limit.description: Memory limit for "qemu-img convert" in MiB.

image_convert_attempts.description: Number of attempts to convert an image.

metrics_backend.description: Backend to use for the metrics system.

metrics_prepend_host.description: Prepend the hostname to all metric names.

metrics_prepend_host_reverse.description: Split the prepended host value by "." and reverse it.

metrics_global_prefix.description: Prefix all metric names with this value.

metrics_statsd_host.description: Host for use with the statsd backend.

metrics_statsd_port.description: Port to use with the statsd backend.
